crossRefs.note: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for…
God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.
Yahweh said to Samuel, “Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.

people.name: Hophni
people.line: A corrupt priest, son of Eli.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

people.name: Phinehas
people.line: Wicked son of Eli the priest

translations.web: He who brought the news answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and God’s ark has been captured.”
translations.bsb: The messenger answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are both dead, and the ark of God has been captured.”
translations.kjv: And the messenger answered and said, Israel is fled before the Philistines, and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people, and thy two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God is taken.
translations.asv: And he that brought the tidings answered and said, Israel is fled before the Philistines, and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people, and thy two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God is taken.
